# Vendored third-party code

| File | Upstream | Version | License |
|------|----------|---------|---------|
| `monocypher.c`, `monocypher.h` | https://monocypher.org (Loup Vaillant et al.) | 4.0.2 (unmodified) | Dual: **CC0-1.0** (public domain dedication) or BSD-2-Clause — we use it under **CC0-1.0**. Full text: `MONOCYPHER-LICENCE.md` |

Used for: X25519 (`crypto_x25519`, `crypto_x25519_public_key`), ChaCha20 IETF
(`crypto_chacha20_ietf`), Poly1305 (`crypto_poly1305_*`), `crypto_verify16/32`,
`crypto_wipe`. The RFC 8439 AEAD construction itself is assembled in
`src/wgcrypto.c` from these primitives (Monocypher's own `crypto_aead_*` API is
not used).

Written in-tree (no third-party code): BLAKE2s (from RFC 7693), HMAC-BLAKE2s,
WireGuard KDF, TAI64N, JSON parser, IPv4/ICMP/TCP helpers.

Test vectors in `src/selftest_vectors.h` are generated by `tools/wgcheck`
(`go run . vectors`) using `golang.org/x/crypto` with RFC 7693 / RFC 8439 /
RFC 7748 inputs; the RFC-published values (BLAKE2s("abc"), the RFC 8439 §2.8.2
ciphertext/tag, the RFC 7748 §6.1 keys and shared secret) match byte-for-byte.
